title: Generation and Characterization of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell Line UAEUi001-A from an Emirati Patient with Ventricular Septal Defect.
abstract: The absence of induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines derived from Emirati patients with developmental disease hampers region-specific disease modeling and therapeutic research. Herein, we describe the creation of an iPSC line from peripheral blood mononuclear cells obtained from a 21-year-old Emirati female patient with ventricular septal defect (VSD) using Sendai virus-mediated delivery of reprogramming factors. The resulting line, UAEUi001-A, exhibited typical colony morphology, was mycoplasma negative, successfully generated embryoid bodies), and demonstrated strong alkaline phosphatase activity.
